content.value_statement: Instagram Reels need fast hooks, clear topics, and shareable payoffs to reach new viewers. This skill turns a brief, draft, or Insights readout into practical Reels guidance.
actual_capabilities: Drafts 15 to 30 second Reels scripts with timed beats, on-screen text, audio notes, and a send-prompt CTA.
Reviews Reels hooks against first-frame clarity, sound-off legibility, and the three-second drop-off point.
Recommends Trial Reels or direct publishing based on account size, goal, timing, and audience risk.
Diagnoses underperforming Reels using skip rate, share rate, retention, and followers from this post.
Writes captions with a keyword first line, send-prompt CTA, and three to five relevant hashtags.
limitations: It does not guarantee virality or specific reach numbers.
It uses pattern-based guidance, not live Instagram platform data.
It cannot read account analytics unless the user provides the metrics.
Audio and paid-ad advice may need legal review for commercial campaigns.

use_cases.title: Draft a Reel from a Brief
use_cases.description: Turn a product, topic, or customer problem into a structured Reel script with hook, beats, visuals, and CTA.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Weak Reel
use_cases.description: Use shared Insights metrics to identify whether the problem is the hook, topic clarity, share value, or caption.

use_cases.title: Choose a Testing Path
use_cases.description: Decide whether to use Trial Reels, publish directly, or recut a draft before posting to followers.

prompt_templates.title: Write a Simple Reel
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a 20-second Instagram Reel about [topic] for [audience]. Include the hook, visual beats, on-screen text, and CTA.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Hook
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Reels hook: [hook]. Rewrite it for a stronger first frame, sound-off clarity, and a clearer shareable payoff.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose this Reel using these metrics: views [x], skip rate [x], share rate [x], saves [x], followers from this post [x].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Trial Reels Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Trial Reels plan for [campaign]. Include test eligibility, baseline metrics, publish decision rules, and recut recommendations.

output_examples.input: A skincare founder needs a Reel about niacinamide for oily skin.
output: Hook: Stop layering niacinamide after your heaviest cream.
Body: Show the wrong order, then the corrected routine in three quick beats.
CTA: Send this to the friend who buys every new serum.

output_examples.input: A Reel has high views, low shares, and almost no follows.
output_examples.output: The likely issue is topic clarity or weak share value. Recut the first three seconds to name the viewer and replace the CTA with a named-persona send prompt.

output_examples.input: A creator asks whether to use Trial Reels for a launch teaser.
output_examples.output: Use Trial Reels if the goal is cold reach and timing allows a 24-hour read. Publish directly if followers need to see the launch immediately.

best_practices: Provide the Reel goal, audience, account type, and any available Insights metrics.
Ask for one clear output at a time, such as hook review, script draft, or diagnostic readout.
Compare recommendations against your own account baseline before changing the full content strategy.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for guaranteed viral results or exact reach predictions.
Do not use generic CTAs when the goal is sends from cold viewers.
Do not rely on hashtags as the main reach strategy for Reels.

faq.question: Can this skill guarantee a viral Reel?
faq.answer: No. It gives pattern-based guidance that can improve the odds, but it cannot guarantee reach or engagement.

faq.question: Does it need my Instagram login?
faq.answer: No. It works from the brief, draft, caption, or Insights metrics you choose to provide.

faq.question: Can it read my live Instagram analytics?
faq.answer: No. Paste the relevant metrics if you want a diagnostic readout.

faq.question: What metrics should I share for diagnosis?
faq.answer: Share views, skip rate, share rate, saves, retention notes, and followers from the post if available.

faq.question: Does it cover captions and hashtags?
faq.answer: Yes. It writes captions around search-friendly keywords, send-prompt CTAs, and three to five relevant hashtags.

faq.question: Is it useful for TikTok or Shorts?
faq.answer: It is focused on Instagram Reels. Some hook ideas may transfer, but the testing and Insights guidance is Reels-specific.
